# Jenni AI

> Jenni AI is an AI-powered academic writing assistant that helps researchers, students, and academics generate essays, literature reviews, thesis statements, and other scholarly content with built-in citation management.

Jenni AI provides free and premium tools for academic writing, supporting multiple citation formats (APA, MLA, Chicago, LaTeX, RIS) and offering team collaboration plans. The platform combines AI writing assistance with academic integrity features to help overcome writer's block and streamline the research writing process.

## Core Writing Tools

- [AI Essay Writer - Free Essay Maker & Generator](https://jenni.ai/ai-essay-writer): Free essay writer for argumentative, expository, narrative, and descriptive formats.
- [AI Literature Review Generator | Free Account](https://jenni.ai/literature-review-generator): Free literature review generator tool with citation management features.
- [AI Thesis Statement Generator | Use It For Free](https://jenni.ai/thesis-writing-assistant): Free thesis statement generator for essays and research papers.
- [Free AI Essay Outline Generator - Create Effortlessly & Fast!](https://jenni.ai/essay-outline-generator): Free essay outline generator to break writer's block with structured drafts.
- [Free AI Paraphrasing Tool](https://jenni.ai/paraphrasing-tool): Free paraphrasing tool for academic writing clarity and enhancement.
- [Free AI Paragraph Generator](https://jenni.ai/paragraph-generator): Free paragraph generator for academic writing and overcoming writer's block.

## Content Enhancement Tools

- [Free AI Essay Expander: Make Your Essay Longer](https://jenni.ai/expand-my-essay): Free essay expander to enhance depth and explore various writing styles.
- [AI Sentence & Paragraph Expander 100% FREE | Jenni AI](https://jenni.ai/expand-sentences-and-paragraphs): Free sentence and paragraph expander for diverse academic writing styles.
- [AI Summarizer - Free AI Summary Generator | Jenni AI](https://jenni.ai/summarizer): Free AI summarizer for text, articles, and essays with academic integrity.
